review.reason: The core guidance is supported: cited passages require formal R&S specifications with applicability conditions, distinguish warranted from non-guaranteed data, and warn not to rely on battle cards or PR/demo material as technical specifications. The answer slightly overstates the cited competitor evidence because passage [25] shows ordering-style VNA information but does not itself establish competitor status or test conditions, and no cited passage adds semiconductor-specific requirements.
